criteria.description: RETIRED 2026-07-30. Originally: consent-availability gate in the delivery context. Retired on three grounds (see spec.md FR-001). NOTE: the retirement has a recorded SCOPE ERROR -- import-history shares the GateContext but not the dispatcher, so it inherited the retirement without the replacement (FR-028).
criteria.notes: Owner: WP01/T004 (retired). Scope error tracked as FR-028.

criteria.description: A project with NO consent record is denied for delivery, overriding the default-allow fall-through at routing.py:87.
is_sync_enabled_for_checkout denies when routing is unresolvable (routing.py:114-116); no network request is made.
A selected batch spanning >1 project is refused before any POST, names the projects, exits non-zero, and does not mutate retry counts.
Empty selection short-circuits before payload build and reports the real cause, not the no-Private-Teamspace message.
project_uuid/project_slug exist as additive indexed journal columns; a PRE-MIGRATION journal file still opens and reads.
_select_undelivered's universe comes from the project-filtered read; the stored column is the sole selection authority.
The filtered read returns an identity projection (no payload BLOB) and its SQL carries no LIMIT.
Backfill run twice over a 10k-row multi-project journal yields byte-identical column values and unchanged row count.
Identity-less capture is stamped into a named non-deliverable state; NO event is dropped at write time.
Unresolved-identity events are counted (fixture: >=1 nil-sentinel + >=1 NULL) and those rows are absent from the delivered set.
No code path constructs the queue-backed drain; the legacy queue is asserted empty and the removal fails loudly rather than discarding.
Consent index is uuid-keyed; two checkouts of one project with opposite overrides resolve to DENY; unresolvable paths keep an 'unresolved' marker the predicate ignores.
A stable server refusal reason maps to TERMINAL_FAILED in receivers.py and is counted in terminal-failure totals.
sync doctor/status/migrate report per-project depth, oldest age and consent state, reconciled against the journal retained count (NOT OfflineQueue stats).
sync purge --project removes 100% of the target project's rows across journal AND ledger and 0% of any other project's.
sync purge --all empties the store behind explicit confirmation and reports the total removed.
Sync docs state the machine-global scope of SPEC_KITTY_ENABLE_SAAS_SYNC and SPEC_KITTY_SAAS_URL; a CI anchor test fails if the statement is removed.

delivered_project_uuids is a SUBSET of consented_project_uuids AND None is not in delivered. Subset/membership, never cardinality -- identity-less events collapse to {None} and would fake cardinality==1.
2,000 non-consented events older than 10 consented: ONE drain delivers all 10. Predicate applied before the row limit.
100k rows / 20 projects: selecting one project performs no full-table payload decode.
Backfill is idempotent and lossless; no row deleted or mutated outside the two new columns.
Capture-first preserved: no event dropped at write time. A missing_auth-stamped row DOES deliver once the gate clears.
After purging project X, differential row count over all other projects across journal and ledger is zero.
The drain's real batch window (_EVENT_SYNC_DISPATCH_BATCH_LIMIT, cli/commands/sync.py:807-820, halved on 413) is exercised. NOT batch.py's max_events_per_batch, which is dead after WP02.
Incident reproduction: 6 projects, 1 consented, 5 with NO consent record -> only the consented project's events are delivered. FAILS on origin/main at mission start.
Liveness proof, written red-first at the selection seam.
Each fail-closed path denies with NO network request: unresolvable routing, absent consent record, unresolvable identity, multi-project batch, empty selection.
Zero hand-written SQLite queries needed to answer 'whose data is in here?'.
No code path constructs the queue-backed drain.
Purge exactness measured by differential row counts across journal and ledger.
Backfill twice -> byte-identical values, unchanged count.

LIVE drain against spec-kitty-dev at the incident's shape (>=6 projects: 1 consented, >=3 no record, >=1 opt-out, >=1 identity-less). Artefact carries before/after counts per project_slug, the drain's own delivered count, and the CLI commit SHA. NEVER production.
CROSS-INVOCATION: a second sync now selects strictly fewer events than the first. A single-run assertion is already green on origin/main via the dispatcher's exclude set.
RECORDED, NOT DISCHARGED: after this mission the machine still accumulates every project's payloads in one producer-scoped store. Egress is secured; collection is not. Operator decision.
Unreadable machine-global consent state must not read as absent.
criteria.notes: Found and fixed mid-mission; owned by no WP. ConsentLevel.UNDETERMINED + fault-preserving read(); consent_index_health() exposes it. Doctor-surface wiring still owed.

criteria.description: An unreadable project-local file must not defer to a stale machine-index grant.
criteria.notes: Found and fixed mid-mission; owned by no WP. Fails OPEN before the fix (a leak), unlike FR-020 which failed closed. Measurement trap recorded: _reconcile_index side effect makes a shared-home probe read as a denial.

criteria.description: An unreadable project config must not defer to a checkout-level grant.
criteria.notes: Found and fixed mid-mission; owned by no WP. Fence placed BEFORE the identity read, so it closes a leak and a crash together. Proven non-redundant twice by runtime blinding with the bind counted.

criteria.description: A structurally invalid config.yaml must not crash load_identity.
criteria.notes: Found and fixed mid-mission; owned by no WP. Reported as one crash; was FIVE, including one on the write path. Mid-write truncation hypothesis disproved by counting mkstemp calls.

criteria.description: A valid mapping with an unusable uuid value must not crash the policy read.
criteria.notes: Found and fixed mid-mission; owned by no WP. Reported as three shapes; was ELEVEN in three exception flavours, plus an unreported second class in repo_slug where routing died in code entitled to assume a string. Also 11b58403bb, 7ff1ca7dcf (self-caught weak assertions).

criteria.description: The invocation propagator must not read undetermined consent as consent.
criteria.notes: Found and fixed mid-mission; owned by no WP. SEVERITY CORRECTED: the sender is dead in production (FR-032), so the pre-fix 'measured leaking' result had an injected client. Fix lands as defence-in-depth. Three further permissive-default siblings on the same payload fixed in the same commit.

criteria.description: runtime.publish_event must gate on the event's own project_uuid.
criteria.notes: Found and fixed mid-mission; owned by no WP. Twelve production callers, not the one reported: EventEmitter._emit returns the envelope regardless of consent, so the same module POSTed what _route_event had withheld -- M1-1's gate was being routed around by its own module's wrappers.

criteria.description: A field-level shape fault in the consent key must not void a committed refusal.
criteria.notes: Found and fixed mid-mission; owned by no WP. Reported as four shapes; was NINETEEN. enabled: no is a string under ruamel's YAML 1.2. Honest negative recorded: makes the unattributable-fault denial path more reachable.

criteria.description: import-history is an ungated egress path (sixth).
criteria.notes: Found mid-mission; owned by no WP; awaiting fold-or-file decision. Egress inventory E1. Holds the project_uuid and never asks it. This is where FR-001's retirement scope error landed.

criteria.description: The tracker SaaS client is an ungated egress path (seventh).
criteria.notes: Found mid-mission; owned by no WP; awaiting fold-or-file decision. Egress inventory E2. Reachable NON-INTERACTIVELY during mission creation, so no operator action is required.

criteria.description: The generic SaaS client is an ungated egress path (eighth).
criteria.notes: Found mid-mission; owned by no WP; awaiting fold-or-file decision. Egress inventory E3. Four GETs carry mission_id, documented 'ULID or slug', in URL paths.

criteria.description: The body-upload enqueue gate must not fail open or consult the routing chain.
criteria.notes: Found mid-mission; owned by no WP; awaiting fold-or-file decision. Egress inventory E4. The only fail-open gate found on a live-sender path; two defects in one line.

criteria.description: The phantom _ws_client attribute must be resolved deliberately.
criteria.notes: Found mid-mission; owned by no WP; awaiting fold-or-file decision. Disables three senders. Assigning it -- a plausible one-line fix -- makes all three live at once. Invisible to the AST dead-symbol gate because a string-literal getattr is not a reference.

negative_invariants: No event belonging to a project without a consent record is ever POSTed.
No event is dropped at write time (capture-first durability).
No transient drain-blocked reason (missing_auth/missing_team/saas_disabled) permanently excludes an event.
No test asserts delivered-project CARDINALITY in place of subset membership.
No mission activity authenticates against or mutates production.
notes_traceability: FR-020..FR-032 were discovered and (mostly) fixed mid-mission and are owned by no work package -- the WP structure did not anticipate them. They are recorded here rather than retrofitted into ill-fitting WPs, which would be false attribution. FR-019 is defined as a prose subsection in spec.md rather than a table row, so table-parsing extraction misses it.
